verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a global cloud and hosting platform, so a built-in image CDN for on-demand resizing is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents image resizing, image optimization, or an image CDN. The material covers Machines, Sprites, Managed Postgres, volumes and Anycast networking, none of which is this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resize and optimize images on demand via a built-in image CDN
